test_title: PYST 44: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/consonants/vowels in the word)

Cosmology : Universe :: Morphology :_______
solution:
Logic : Term : Study or a branch of knowledge about a specific subject

So,

__
 
• Cosmology is study of the universe.

Similarly,

 
• Morphology is study of structure of living things.

Hence, "Structure Of Living Things" is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Radio → It is the technology of signaling and communication through radio waves.
 
• Structure of living things → Study of Structure of living things is called morphology.
 
• Function → Study of function is called physiology.
 
• Trees → Study of trees is called dendrology.
